copy.release: The special premiere took place on October 9, 2026 at BlackBox in Beirut Media Zone, as reported by Nidaa al-Watan. On October 22, VOX Cinemas Lebanon listed the film as Now Showing, with a release date of October 21 and showtimes at City Centre Beirut. Cinemacity Beirut lists Thursday, October 22. Lebtalks had reported a nationwide Lebanese cinema rollout planned from October 22. An older March 19 database date is not the current release schedule.
copy.status: Status checked October 22, 2026: completed special premiere, current cinema listings and remaining availability gaps are separated below.
copy.confirmed: NMPRO and MTV jointly produced the film, directed by Nadim Mehanna with a screenplay by Claudia Marshalian. Jerry Ghazal plays the young Charbel. The October 9 special premiere at Beirut Media Zone has taken place. As of October 22, VOX Cinemas Lebanon lists the film as Now Showing, with a release date of October 21 and showtimes at City Centre Beirut; Cinemacity Beirut lists a Thursday, October 22 date. A listing is not a seat guarantee, so check sessions with your cinema.
